page_findings.591: Electroacoustic introduction and technical requirements: equipment,operators,configuration and preface instructions;2011 source context,not a current equipment recommendation.
page_findings.592: Score function determines information. Analytical documentation may be detailed; performing score supplies coordination/technician needs. Raw waveform usually insufficient for pitch/timbre. Fixed recording still needs start/stop,duration,balance.
page_findings.593: Start/end brackets,track numbers and distinctive pitch/rhythm cues support coordination. Cue chord reduction differs from deleting actual performed piano voices.
page_findings.594: Proportional spacing may suit nonmetrical/no-pulse electronic material; extenders clarify sustained duration,stemless heads can mark events alone. Not uniform ordinary-piano spacing.
page_findings.595: Graphic bands can convey duration,pitch range,timbre/density,with concise definitions; separate simultaneous timbres when useful. Not a waveform-to-notation algorithm.
page_findings.596: Electronic staff position depends on role: technical/dense background may be bottom; interactive part near triggering performer; normal cue placement in parts.
page_findings.597: Brackets/labels distinguish materials. Cue size suits background,but full size when precise coordination/detail requires it. Different reader tasks justify different emphasis.
page_findings.598: Distinct operational frames distinguish rehearsal/track/program. Critical trigger aligned by arrow/dotted guide. Three dynamic sources:prerecorded/software,technician fader,performer transformation. Discussion continues599.
